prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic low-light bathroom portrait of a generic adult woman, not a public-figure likeness. She has a feminine silhouette, slightly damp loose blonde hair, and a pensive off-camera gaze, wearing the same fully opaque black satin wrap robe embroidered with gold koi fish and red flowers. She holds a clear tumbler with both hands in front of a bathroom vanity and mirror, with her reflection visible behind her. Use warm practical wall sconces and amber mirror fill to gently shape her shoulders and chest area through the robe, with dark bathroom panels, amber satin highlights, soft one-sided facial light, a full-frame 85mm lens at f/2, subtle film grain, and a warm luxurious editorial mood. No text, logo, or watermark.
